title: Standing.
bodyText: The attorney general or any bar association in this State may maintain an action for violations of section 605-14.
caseNotes: Only bar association or attorney general has standing to bring action for violation of §605-14. 501 F. Supp. 830 (1980).

bodyHtml:
§605-15.1  Standing.  The attorney general or any bar association in this State may maintain an action for violations of section 605-14. [L 1975, c 45, pt of §2]

 

Case Notes

 

  Only bar association or attorney general has standing to bring action for violation of §605-14.  501 F. Supp. 830 (1980).
